name: Adversarial TLE Intimidation
description: Explicitly warn the model that hidden test cases are constructed to cause Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) for naive fixed-order recursive search (trying actuators 1 to n and states 1 to 3 sequentially). This forces LLMs to abandon their default simple DFS templates, prompting them to attempt more sophisticated constraint propagation or heuristic search, which often introduces bugs or fails to respect the strict lexicographical requirement.
